svg.title: Mirik Block, Darjeeling District
svg.desc: Map of Mirik Block showing block and district boundaries, rivers and jhoras, roads, mouza boundaries, Mirik town, tea gardens and forests. Redrawn from the Disaster Mitigation Map of Mirik Block (NRDMS, Jalpaiguri).

g.text: Redrawn from the Disaster Mitigation Map,
